findings.title: Example of a finding that verifies
findings.claim: gotiPopPK applies the published dialysis factor of 0.7 to clearance.

impact.clinical: Dialysis patients would be over-dosed if the factor were omitted.
impact.magnitude: CL is 30% lower on dialysis: 4.5 -> 3.15 L/h at CrCl 120.

reproduction.script: const a = gotiPopPK(120, 70, false); const b = gotiPopPK(120, 70, true); print({ ratio: +(b.TVCL / a.TVCL).toFixed(4) });

findings.disconfirming_test: If gotiPopPK(...,true).TVCL / gotiPopPK(...,false).TVCL != 0.7, the claim is wrong.

proposed_fix.summary: No change needed; this is the control case.

findings.title: Example of a FALSE claim — reproduction contradicts it
findings.claim: calcIBW returns 50 kg for a 152.4 cm female.

impact.clinical: Would inflate IBW for short women.

findings.title: Example of an unverifiable citation
findings.claim: Some paper says vancomycin clearance equals 9.9 times creatinine clearance.

citation.quote: clearance is exactly nine point nine times creatinine clearance

findings.disconfirming_test: The quote is absent from the source.
